mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A replacement 204DTD engine for the Discovery Sport D150 typically costs between £1,500 and £6,500 depending on condition type: used engines from £1,500-£3,000, reconditioned from £2,500-£4,500, and rebuilt/remanufactured from £4,000-£6,500. Supply and fit adds approximately £800-£1,500 in labour. Dealer pricing for a full replacement can exceed £10,000.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of timing chain failure in a Discovery Sport D150?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 204DTD Ingenium diesel is known for timing chain stretch, particularly on pre-2019 examples. Common symptoms include rattling noise on cold start, power loss, rough idling, engine misfires, and in severe cases, the engine failing to start. If the chain snaps, the engine will not start and internal damage (bent valves, damaged pistons) is almost certain.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Discovery Sport D150?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your vehicle's value and the extent of the damage. A typical 2017-2019 Discovery Sport D150 is worth £13,000-£21,000, with earlier examples from around £8,995. If your car is worth over £8,000-£10,000, a rebuilt engine with warranty is usually a sound investment. If the car is worth under £5,000, a used engine or repair may be more economical.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Discovery Sport D150 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full engine replacement on a Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 typically takes 2-4 working days for supply and fit through a specialist. This includes removal of the old unit, preparation of the replacement engine, installation, and testing. Turnaround may vary depending on parts availability and workshop workload.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the Discovery Sport D150 and D180 engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both use the 2.0-litre Ingenium diesel (204DTD family), but the D180 is a higher-output tune producing 180PS (132kW) and 430Nm versus the D150's 150PS (110kW) and 380Nm. The engines share the same basic architecture and many components, but the D180 features different turbocharging and ECU calibration. Engine replacement costs for the D180 are typically higher due to the more complex turbo setup.

mainEntity.name: What warranty comes with a replacement Discovery Sport D150 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every rebuilt or reconditioned engine supplied through EnginesMarket carries a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Used engines may come with a shorter warranty (typically 3-6 months) depending on the supplier. Always confirm exact warranty terms - including what is and isn't covered - with your chosen specialist before purchase.

historyTimeline.h2: Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Discovery Sport D150 is the entry-level diesel variant of Land Rover's compact SUV, positioned as the most fuel-efficient and accessible option in the range. Launched in 2015 as part of the Ingenium engine family rollout, the D150 replaced the earlier 2.2-litre diesel from the Freelander with a lighter, more efficient 2.0-litre four-cylinder unit.

milestones.description: 204DTD Ingenium diesel introduced in the Discovery Sport as the eD4 (148bhp / 150PS), replacing the 2.2-litre SD4
Facelift (L550) introduces mild-hybrid (MHEV) technology to the D150, adding a belt-integrated starter generator and 48V battery for improved efficiency and reduced emissions
2026 - 204DTD continues in production with EU6d-TEMP emissions compliance, available in both front-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive configurations

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The 204DTD Ingenium diesel is a broadly capable unit, but early examples (2015-2019) have well-documented timing chain vulnerabilities that drive replacement demand. Later cars received revised components, but failures still occur. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded timing components addressing the original failure point, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Failure - Why the Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 204DTD Suffers Premature Chain Stretch
problems.affectedModels: Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 (204DTD, 2015-2019 particularly; later examples less common but not immune)
problems.rootCause: Early timing chains stretch due to inadequate tensioner design and oil pressure issues. When chains fail on an interference engine, pistons collide with valves, bending valves and damaging cylinder heads. Plastic chain guide fragments can enter the oil system, blocking oil galleries, the oil pump, turbo feed and piston cooling jets.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace timing chain, tensioners, guides and oil pump if required
repairOptions.longevity: Best for high-mileage cars with no symptoms yet - prevents catastrophic failure

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded timing components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Best if chain has snapped or engine has suffered internal damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical 2017-2019 Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 is worth approximately £13,000-£21,000, with earlier/higher-mileage examples from around £8,995. For a Discovery Sport D150 valued under ~£8,000, a used engine or repair may make more sense than a full rebuilt unit. For cars valued £8,000-£15,000, a reconditioned or rebuilt engine typically justifies the premium via warranty and reliability. For cars over £15,000, replacement cost is usually small relative to vehicle value.
problems.recommendation: If your Discovery Sport D150 has no timing chain symptoms but is approaching 70,000-80,000 miles, preventative chain replacement at a specialist is a sound investment - far cheaper than a full engine replacement later. If the chain has already snapped or you have significant oil contamination, replacement with a rebuilt engine (with upgraded components) is usually the most cost-effective long-term solution. Always factor in the vehicle's current market value before committing.

problems.h4: DPF Blockage - Why Short Journeys Cause Problems for the Discovery Sport D150
problems.affectedModels: Land Rover Discovery Sport D150 (204DTD, all years)
problems.rootCause: The 204DTD's diesel particulate filter (DPF) requires regular motorway driving to regenerate. Repeated short journeys prevent regeneration, leading to frequent "exhaust filter full" warnings.

repairOptions.longevity: Best for occasional blockages with no permanent damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: As above - DPF repairs should be weighed against the vehicle's current value. For older, lower-value examples, evaluate whether repair costs are proportionate.
problems.recommendation: If you primarily drive short urban journeys, consider a petrol or hybrid alternative. For mixed-use D150 owners, ensure regular motorway runs (20+ minutes at 50mph+) to allow passive regeneration. If DPF warnings become frequent, have the system diagnosed promptly - ignoring the issue can lead to back-pressure damage and more expensive repairs.
